name: server-keys

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. `custody-import-rule.test.ts` lints sample imports with the key custody block of the workspace Oxlint configuration and the local plugin it uses, so a change to `.oxlintrc.json`, to `tools/oxlint/qauth-plugin.mjs` or to Oxlint itself must re-run it (TypeScript reads the configuration's comments). Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, with `oxlint` and `typescript` added to the external dependencies.

test-integration.description: Run the Docker-backed key creation tests against the migrated schema (testcontainers Postgres). Requires a running Docker daemon.
